plan_review.notes: Adopted: forced spells unlock the spell feature; passives synchronize and stats recompute before frame 0; weapon prerequisites validate against the selected loadout; activation counts derive from the authoritative run-event collector rather than the capped cosmetic queue; forced active ordering is deduplicated CLI order plus remaining existing slots after prevalidation; tests use maxFrames:0 state inspection plus a deterministic activation seam. No different architecture warranted.
